sources.label: OSM n610921621 · railway=subway_entrance (Metrorex, Grozavesti west); no OSM building
District dossier: Metrorex entrance style and the Grozavesti west entrance

improvements: The Grozavesti metro west entrance is a low glazed pavilion with grey metal frames, a shallow white roof and the blue Metrorex M on its east front, standing 3 m west of the mapped entrance node.
remainingGaps: No OSM building: the 10 × 6 m footprint, the heights and the position 3 m west of the door node are estimates from the panorama (viewed only). The registry declares no replacement source id.
In the district view the pavilion is small in the middle distance.
